deploymentNotes.stackName: CloudFormation stack name for your deployment
deploymentNotes.s3Region: AWS region for S3 bucket (us-east-2 recommended)
deploymentNotes.cfRegion: CloudFront region (always us-east-1 for SSL certificates)
deploymentNotes.usesExistingBucket: Whether using an existing bucket with prefix
deploymentNotes.websiteUrl: Final HTTPS URL of your deployed site
deploymentNotes.sslCertificateArn: ACM certificate ARN for custom domain
deploymentNotes.awsProfile: AWS CLI profile to use (for SSO or multi-account setups)
deploymentNotes.lastDeployment: ISO timestamp of last successful deployment
